mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, we are enjoying clear skies near Harriet Park. The temperature is 66 degrees, and we expect an overnight low of 56 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city updates, the Common Council recently adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to manage future growth. Additionally, the city has successfully maintained its Moody's Aa1 financial rating.

There is plenty to do this week. Catch live music tomorrow at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, check out yoga at Insight Wellness on October 12, or join trivia nights at Hop Haus and Paddy Mac's starting early next week.
Looking at the weekly report, on October 3, a 19-year-old Verona man was arrested following a tip from the Cottage Grove Police Department, resulting in the recovery of a stolen firearm.
Today's flavor of the day was Raspberry Cheesecake. Since the store is now closed for the evening, please look forward to tomorrow's flavor, Caramel Cashew, when the doors open tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
